Class WhoProblems

java.lang.Object
org.jwcarman.who.spring.security.web.WhoProblems
public final class WhoProblems extends Object
Builds and writes WhoProblems, who's answer to every error under its base path. Every error gets a code: a who exception its own, anything else one named from its status.

    • write

      public static void write(jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest request, jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletResponse response, Exception exception, org.springframework.http.HttpStatus fallback) throws IOException
      Answers exception with its problem: the status, the Who-Error header and the body. A 5xx is logged at ERROR with its stack trace first. A committed response is left alone.
      Parameters:
      request - the request
      response - the response
      exception - what went wrong
      fallback - the status when nothing about the exception names one
      Throws:
      IOException - if writing fails
